newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat called up 2 to 3 cents on dry weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat called up 2 to 3 cents on dry weather.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were expected to open two to three cents per bushel higher on concerns about too-dry conditions in western Kansas, traders said.
"We're going to be up on weather concerns in Western Kansas," said a floor trader.
Some long-term forecasts show hot and dry conditions in that region, and soil is already too dry there, crop scouts said earlier.

Shortcovering before USDA's winter wheat production report on Monday was also expected to push prices higher, traders said. An average of analysts' estimates put total wheat production at 1.574 billion bushels.
